levels.name: Easy
levels.tagline: plays the first card that fits

levels.name: Normal
levels.tagline: saves its wilds and picks its colours

help.goal: Be the first to get rid of every card in your hand.
steps: Match the top card of the pile by colour or by symbol.
Tap a card to play it, or flick it up at the pile.
Play a wild and the pick a color box asks for a colour.
Nothing playable? Tap Draw a card.
If what you drew fits, play it or tap Keep it to pass.
notes: Wild lets you name the next colour. +4 does the same and makes the next player draw four.
+2 and +4 make the next player draw and lose their turn. There is no stacking.
Skip loses the next player a turn. Reverse flips the direction, or acts as a skip with two players.
